scoring_justification: Recomputing breaking forces from raw DFT trajectories in verifier sandbox is infeasible; compare agent-reported forces and bond types to paper's reported gold values with tolerance ±0.2 nN.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference forces and bond types for T1–T5
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 (breaking force and breaking bond columns)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Inline hardcoded from paper's reported values: T1 0.6 nN thiol‑Au, T2 0.6 nN thiol‑Au, T3 2.2 nN S‑Au, T4 1.5 nN H‑Au, T5 1.5 nN H‑Au.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values directly quoted from paper's main result table; used to score reproduction accuracy.

outputs.description: Breaking force (nN) and breaking bond type for each of the five junction types T1–T5, extracted from the DFT elongation simulations.
Total energy vs junction length curves for each junction type, used to verify structural consistency (monotonic length increase, plateau after breakdown, presence of all five junction types).

output_contract.notes: The breaking forces and bond types are compared against the paper's central reported values; energy curves are checked for monotonicity and presence of a post-break plateau. No gold values or tolerances are revealed here.

steps.description: Compare breaking forces and bond types to paper reference. Forces within ±0.2 nN and exact bond match.
Structural audit of energy‑length curves: presence of all five junction types, monotonic length increase, energy plateau after breakdown.
